notes: A multi-stage numeric pipeline that must honor a forbidden-library constraint (handwritten RK4 — importing scipy.integrate/optimize, sympy, torch or odeint fails the denylist), recompile+rerun a shipped Fortran regenerator to produce a specific sum-pattern file, read a MATLAB source file and mirror its array/ordering semantics (elementwise ops, flip/reverse, odd-index ramp, endpoint concat), match every derived quantity within tight rtol against an independently-computed reference, and keep a softmax-attention risk estimator finite and normalized across extreme-small/extreme-large/single-instance/variable-length/empty bags. Hard: four hidden case files exercise generalization to fresh numeric parameters plus edge/malformed inputs (empty risk bag, single giant bag, tiny magnitudes with zero-valued elements and mismatched weight length, tmax=0). Each output is quantitative so small drift fails; the RK4 reference and MATLAB port both have to reproduce the exact same numeric stack, which is why quantitative_correctness and hidden_case_generalization are 3, dependent_stages 3 for the chained regen->ode->gamma->risk artifacts, tool_breadth 3 for python+subprocess+gfortran compile.
